newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris says no decision yet on Thomson-CSF links.
newsitem.headline: Paris says no decision yet on Thomson-CSF links.

text.p: The French government denied on Tuesday that it had made any decisions about future alliances for defence electronics firm Thomson-CSF.
"No choice has been made regarding Thomson, as far as the operator itself is concerned nor as far as alliances to be made are concerned," Prime Minister Lionel Jospin's office said.
"There is no pre-decision. That would run counter to the rules and procedures," Jospin's office said.

The government cancelled on Friday the planned privatisation of Thomson-CSF saying the method chosen by the previous government did not protect the interests of the state, the company or its employees.

French newspapers have speculated that the government plans to ally Thomson-CSF with Alcatel Alsthom and Aerospatiale and Dassault Aviation to create a French industry giant before embarking on alliances with other European defence companies.
